Per Court :

The applicant claims to have an apprehension of being arrested in connection with Crime No. 238 of 2019 registered with Vaijapur Police Station, Dist. Aurangabad for the offences punishable under Sections 272,
273, 188, 328 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
2. Heard.
Perused the F.I.R. and relevant papers filed by the investigating officer.

sentences.text: The F.I.R. has been lodged by the Food Safety Officer.
It is alleged in the F.I.R. that on 09th July, 2019 at about 05.30 p.m. one Tushar Kailas
Sale was found in possession of contraband food articles viz. R.M.D. Pan Masala packets (14) and scented tobacco packets (14).
On enquiry with Tushar Sale, he disclosed to have bought those articles from one Javed Shabbir Shaikh, resident of Vaijapur.
Name of the applicant is said to have been disclosed by co-accused - Javed Shabbir Shaikh.
4. The contraband food articles have already been recovered from accused - Tushar Sale.
He claims to have bought the same from co-accused - Javed Shabbir Shaikh.

It needs no mention that except so called information given by co-accused - Javed Shabbir Shaikh suggesting to have bought contraband articles from one Shoheb Ansari, there is nothing to connect the applicant with the offence in question.

As such, case is made out to grant anticipatory bail in terms of the following order :-
 ORDER  (I) Application is allowed.

(II) In the event of arrest of the applicant in connection with Crime No. 238 of 2019 registered with Vaijapur Police Station, Dist. Aurangabad for the offences punishable under Sections 272, 273, 188, 328 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, the applicant be released on executing P.R. bond in the sum of Rs.15,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Thousand) with surety in the like Shoheb Khan Ismail Khan vs The State Of Maharashtra on 13 November, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/85208490/
